title: Theme utilities
description: Functions and theme objects to resolve, apply and inspect themes outside of ConfigProvider.

reference.title: Reference
reference.text: ConfigProvider and useAutoTheme are built on these helpers. Use them to apply a theme without React, to theme a single element, or to read token values.
reference.name: Name
reference.applyThemeStyles: Resolves a theme and writes it as CSS variables on <html> (global). Variables of the previous theme that the new one doesn't define are removed.
reference.generateCSSVariables: Writes every token of a theme object as --<token> on the given style declaration (e.g. element.style) and removes stale ones. Use it to theme one element.
reference.resolveTheme: Turns any accepted theme value into a theme object: "auto" and { light, dark } pairs use systemTheme, names are looked up in themes, objects are returned as is. Throws for unknown names. Pure.
reference.getSystemTheme: Returns the operating system color scheme from prefers-color-scheme; "light" when matchMedia is unavailable (SSR, tests).
reference.isBilingualTheme: Type guard: true for { light, dark } pairs of theme objects.
reference.themes: The built-in themes keyed by the names accepted by the theme prop.
reference.builtIns: The built-in theme objects, also exported individually; spread them to create custom themes.

usage.applyText: applyThemeStyles is what ConfigProvider calls. Use it in non-React code, or to apply the theme before the first render to avoid a flash of the default colors.
usage.generateText: generateCSSVariables accepts any CSSStyleDeclaration, so the tokens can be scoped to an element: its descendants inherit them.
usage.resolveText: resolveTheme, isBilingualTheme and getSystemTheme have no side effects; use them to compute token values, e.g. to style a canvas or a chart.

ThemeProps.description: Base design tokens. Every key is written to the document root as a CSS custom property named `--<key>` (e.g. `"primary-color"` -> `--primary-color`) by `applyThemeStyles` / `ConfigProvider`. Components never read these values directly from JS: their styles consume the CSS variables, so switching theme is a pure CSS-variable swap. Most semantic tokens (see `ComponentThemeProps`) are derived from these keys with `color-mix()`, so a custom theme only has to provide the base keys below.

props.name: primary-color
props.description: Brand / accent color: primary buttons, active states, focus rings.

props.name: text-gray
props.description: Secondary, low-emphasis text (should keep >= 4.5:1 on the background).

props.name: muted-color
props.description: Muted UI color (placeholders, icons, inactive controls).

SemanticThemeProps.description: Optional semantic tokens. All of them have defaults declared on `:root` in `minerva-design/tokens.css` (`tokens/default-theme.ts`), derived from the base `ThemeProps` keys with `color-mix()`, so they follow any theme (including custom ones). Set them in a theme only when the derived value is not what you want (the built-in dark themes set explicit surface and text colors, for example).

props.name: surface-color
props.description: Background of cards, inputs and other component surfaces.

props.name: surface-subtle-color
props.description: Very soft background (sidebars, table headers, code blocks).

props.name: canvas-color
props.description: Application background behind surfaces (e.g. AppShell canvas).

props.name: accent-color
props.description: Secondary accent (CTAs, ratings, highlights). Defaults to the primary color.

props.name: readonly-surface-color
props.description: Read-only field surface; content keeps normal text contrast and focus.

props.name: control-border-color
props.description: Necessary boundary of editable controls; distinct from decorative dividers.

props.name: text-inverse-color
props.description: Text drawn on filled role backgrounds (e.g. a primary button).

ComponentThemeProps.description: Optional per-component overrides. Components fall back to the semantic tokens when these are not set.

props.name: btn-bg-color-hover
props.description: Overrides the hover background of primary buttons.

props.name: btn-bg-color-active
props.description: Overrides the active background of primary buttons.

examples.title: Resolving a theme value
examples.description: How resolveTheme resolves each kind of theme value for a given system scheme, and what isBilingualTheme / getSystemTheme return.

examples.title: Previewing a theme in an element
examples.description: generateCSSVariables writes a resolved theme on a container's style, so only the components inside it change.

examples.title: Built-in themes
examples.description: Reads token values from the themes map and renders them as swatches. No CSS variable is written.

ThemeProps.secondary-gradient-end: End color of the secondary gradient.
ThemeProps.shadow-color: Base shadow color used by --shadow-sm, --shadow-md and --shadow-lg.
ThemeProps.muted-color: Muted UI color (placeholders, icons, inactive controls).
